notes.title: The Rhythm Dodge DEMO launch!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to share that the Rhythm Dodge demo is now available to play! This demo will give a slight view of what's to come in the complete game. I'm always looking forward to your feedback and suggestions to make the game better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344924/77a767534dae2e3de84dc78247ce49badec9d974.png[/img]

[b]What is Rhythm Dodge?[/b]
Rhythm Dodge is a retro styled music based game where instead of hitting notes on the rhythm of the music you have to dodge them. You play as two sides that you control independently. Making you test your eye-hand coordination.

[b]Where can I post my feedback?[/b]
First of all, thank you for checking out Rhythm Dodge! Please share and feedback and suggestions you have in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/d54RNSDe9k]Discord Server[/url]. Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable as I continue to refine and improve the game, while I work towards a full release. Be sure to wishlist the game, I appreciate the support. Stay tuned for more updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2502400/Rhythm_Dodge/
